media.caption_html:
Optional fingerprint override (flashable zip)

Place a config file on the device before flashing to optionally spoof ro.build.fingerprint (useful for Play certification style setups).

Checked in order (first found wins):

/sdcard/mtg-config.txt
/sdcard/MindTheGapps.prop
Same directory as the zip being flashed
Example:
# fingerprint: none | fugu | cheets | tangorpro
fingerprint=tangorpro

# props_mode: fingerprint | full
props_mode=fingerprint
